question: What happens when someone uses Greenhouse?
diagram:
flowchart LR
  P["You · in a plan"]
  P2["Teammate · watching the same plan"]
  REL["You · releasing a feature"]
  subgraph cf["Runs on Cloudflare"]
    W["Web app"]
    A["API · knows every plan room"]
    RW["Rules and shared words"]
    R[("Plan room · one per plan · what happened, in order")]
    D[("Settings, accounts and the list of plan rooms · switches, who can sign in, who is where")]
  end
  subgraph ag["Agent"]
    AG["Agent · a participant like you"]
    CP[("Agent memory · every step saved")]
  end
  CK["Workshop check-in · a separate small app"]
  P -- "opens a plan, writes, decides" --> W
  W -- "asks on your behalf" --> A
  A -- "is this on for you?" --> D
  A -- "follows" --> RW
  A -- "records it" --> R
  R -- "shows it at once" --> P2
  R -- "says who is here" --> D
  AG -- "answers @agent, streams, writes into the plan" --> A
  AG -- "saves each step" --> CP
  REL -- "on for a few, then everyone" --> D

steps.caption: You open a plan in the web app and write, reply or decide.
The web app asks the API, which knows every plan room and who is in each.
The API checks whether this feature is switched on for you.
If it is, the API follows the rules and the plan room records what happened.
Everyone in the plan sees the change at once, and the room tells the API who is here.
Mention @agent in chat: it answers as it writes, draws or edits the plan, through the same steps as you.
The agent saves every step, so a crash picks up exactly where it stopped.
A new feature starts switched off, then goes on for you, a few people, and everyone.
